_comments: The on-submit automation drain (#303). FormsAutomationDrainDriver lives in
forms-core-entities-server (automation/outbox/) and registers under this DriverClass.
It claims due FormAutomationEvent rows under a lease, runs each response's automations, and
settles the row. The submitting process drains its own events right after commit; this type
is the durable safety net that picks up retries and anything a crashed process left behind.
No sync block: seeding ships in the release's consolidated Metadata_Sync.

fields.Name: Forms Automation Outbox Drain
fields.Description: Runs the on-submit automations MJ Forms queued in its FormAutomationEvent outbox: claims due events under a lease (one drain per event, oldest first per response), runs their steps, and settles each as Complete, a backed-off retry, DeadLetter or Abandoned. Takes no Configuration.
